description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and a job application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more).

summary.one_liner: An open-source AI job search agent that runs locally inside your AI coding CLI to scan job boards, score postings against your CV, tailor resumes and cover letters, and track applications, leaving the final submit to you.
summary.what_it_does: career-ops is a set of markdown instruction files, Node.js scripts and an HTML/Playwright PDF pipeline that run inside an AI coding CLI such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or Grok. You paste a job URL or description and it checks whether the posting is still open, scores the role against your CV on an A-H evaluation, and drafts a tailored ATS-readable CV, cover letter and application answers. It scans a pre-configured list of 100+ companies and job boards (Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, Wellfound and others) plus custom search queries, and tracks applications in a markdown-based tracker with a terminal dashboard. Additional modes cover interview prep and stories, company research, LinkedIn contact drafting, follow-up cadence, reply classification and offer reading. The README states it never submits applications or sends email; it only drafts and fills.
use_cases: Scan job boards and rank new postings by fit against my CV
Tailor a resume and cover letter to a specific job description
Decide whether a job is worth applying to before writing anything
Prepare for interviews with STAR stories and practice questions
Track application status and follow-up dates in one place
Draft recruiter or referral emails and LinkedIn messages without sending them
how_to_run: claude  # or codex / opencode / qwen / agy / grok, opened in this directory
On first launch, answer the setup questions in chat (CV, profile, target roles)
Paste a job URL or JD text, or run /career-ops
Manual alternative: git clone the repo, run npm install, then npx playwright install chromium (only needed for PDF generation)
stack: HTML template for CV and cover letter
Go with Bubble Tea and Lipgloss for dashboard TUI
Markdown tables, YAML config and TSV files for data
Optional undici dependency for proxy scanning
AI coding CLIs: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity, Grok, Pi, Qwen
notable: Human-in-the-loop by design: drafts and fills forms but never submits; the README says the script never POSTs applications
Fact-check step in generate-pdf blocks a CV whose numbers or facts are not in your sources, unless --skip-fact-check is passed
Works with free or local models (OpenRouter free models, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible endpoints) as described in docs/RUNNING_ON_A_BUDGET.md
Pre-configured portal scanner for 100+ companies with optional Playwright liveness check (--verify)
Runs as an installable Claude plugin for the Claude desktop app Code tab, with data stored outside the plugin
caveats: CV rewording is not fully verified: the README says the fact check cannot judge every rewording, so every CV must be read before sending
Requires an AI coding CLI or API provider; your CV goes to the AI provider you choose, and API usage may bill per token
PDF generation needs Playwright Chromium, and non-Debian/Ubuntu Linux may need system libraries installed manually
Web UI is described as experimental alpha and opt-in; slash commands are not guaranteed in Codex
